instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an indoor study room. On the left, the woman in the beige pantsuit (R2) stands upright, smiling in profile. On the right, the man in the blue turtleneck (R1) stands fully upright, smiling back at her. They are shaking right hands over a wooden table in the foreground. The table features a colorful Scrabble board and educational books. The man holds a smartphone in his left hand. Warm, soft overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows and creating a friendly, professional atmosphere.
